'''Revelation Beat It, Luke! It's MY Turn To Learn!''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Revelation]]
* '''Published:''' 2 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif|label=Mind What You Have Learned}}
* '''Strategy:''' Mind What You Have Learned
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 MWYHL Revelation LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Ok, so everyone trains DOS, doesn't Luke HAVE to be a little upset?

== Strategy ==

First Turn: Reflection and Bionic Hand. Activate 3 by yourself.  Pull the Training Area, pull Great Warrior, deploy Daughter Of Skywalker to the training area from reserve deck, deploy Reflection on her, deploy the backpack on her from reserve; reshuffle. Second turn: Activate 5 by yourself. Deploy Yoda from reserve deck; reshuffle. Take A Jedi?s Strength into hand. Deploy Yoda?s Hope on Yoda from reserve, put him in the backpack. Deploy Yoda?s Hut from reserve. Deploy A Jedi?s Strength on Yoda?s Hut. Third Turn: Activate 8 by yourself. Signal for Traffic Control. Now attempt Test #1. It requires your total to be over 12. You have 5(DOS)+1(Yoda)+1(backpack)+1(Wise Advice)+1(Reflection)+1(Yoda?s Hope)+2(2 DAG sites)=12. So you need to draw a 1. Think you can do that? Okay, so Test 1 is completed. Deploy Traffic Control. Take Domain Of Evil into hand. Deploy a random DAG site from reserve. Maybe deploy an Arcona or two. Move Daughter to the Hut if he didn?t move to you. Fourth turn: Activate 10 or something. Attempt Test 2. You have: 5+1+1+1+1+1+3=13, so again you need to draw a 1. Then deploy Domain Of Evil, and it is automatically completed (The Way Of Things). Take test 4 into hand, deploy a random DAG site, maybe put another Arcona down or something, deploy Test 4 at Yoda?s Hut. Fifth turn: Attempt Test 4. Again, you need a 1. Complete Test 4. Take test 5 into hand, get your last DAG site, pull any card you want out of reserve (On The Edge or something). Fifth turn: Draw a 1 and complete Test 4. Put Bionic Hand back into your deck. Deploy Test 5 and turn Leia upside down. Don?t pull a card out of reserve deck. Sixth turn: Activate up to the Bionic Hand. Turn Leia rightside up, draw the Bionic Hand and stack it on Test 5. That?s a 7. Now pull any card you want (like On The Edge). Now edge twice to retrieve 12. You can start attacking WILDLY next turn. Seventh turn: Pull Test 6, deploy it (whoo! Remember, unless Vader draws a 6 or 7, he LOSES the duel! An extra 7 in every battle! If he?s scared and doesn?t deploy Vader, pingpingipng 2forceloss2forceloss). pull I?ve Got A Bad Feeling About This from reserve. Deploy somewhere where opponent has more power. Initiate with the interrupt. Clash and Blaster Proficiency somebody(or somebodies), draw 7s all the time and make him lose twice (or thrice) battle damage. Once you flip tis simple. Edge back all your lost force. Matchups:

It?s all the same : )
